messages:
maria: incident-bot just fired a PagerDuty alert for service `inference-api-prod` — getting pages from platform-oncall instead of inference-oncall. seeing 5xx spike in metrics. link: https://console.redwood/alerts/ALRT-9087
incident-bot: PagerDuty Alert - High error rate detected
service: inference-api-prod
escalation_policy: platform-default
alert_id: PD-3321
raj: acked the PD page (PD-3321) but routing looks off. PD shows target: `platform-oncall` (team: infra). that doesn't match our expected escalation.
lee: i actually received the page in platform channel but i'm not on inference rota. i'm on AO coverage. @ops-rotation can you confirm current schedule bindings?
ops-rotation: Active schedules:
- inference-oncall: alice (primary)
- platform-oncall: platform-team (primary)
Shadow/overlay rules active: `night-overlay` -> routes alerts tagged `inference-night` to `platform-oncall` as a fallback (created by automation).
alice: i did not see this alert. PD shows it targeted `platform-oncall` — i think the night-overlay alias matched a tag from the alert payload. i see an automation change at 03:12UTC from `deploy-runbook-bot` that added a shadow alias.
maria: customer impact: a subset of requests returned 503s between 12:34 and 12:38 UTC (ingress error rate spike). affected customers likely limited; SLI error rate hit 1.8% briefly. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/inf-api?range=10m
raj: quick mitigation idea: rebind PD service to correct escalation policy to stop further misrouting. command i usually run:```
pd service edit PD_SERVICE_ID --escalation-policy inference-oncall-policy-id
```
lee: i tried to create a manual reroute in PD but PD UI requires owner perms for that service. @alice can you perform the rebind?
alice: doing the rebind now. running PD CLI and updating service binding...
alice: pd audit log:
```
2026-03-15T12:40:12Z pd.service.update id=PD-3321 by=alice field=escalation_policy old=platform-default new=inference-oncall-policy-id
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Service update complete — escalation policy is now `inference-oncall`. pages should target the correct rota going forward.
ops-rotation: root cause note: recent automation that created `shadow-service` aliases matches tag `inference-night` and had higher priority than intended. filing follow-up: https://issues.redwood/IO-421 (ops automation review).
maria: mitigation: traffic rerouted, we saw error rate drop back to baseline by 12:49 UTC. customer impact classified as "brief degraded availability" — drafting advisory.
raj: post-incident actions: 1) remove or scope shadow alias, 2) add PD binding tests in CI, 3) require manual approval for changes to escalation bindings. @maria want to own the postmortem?
maria: i'll own the postmortem and collect logs/runbook gaps. i'll link doc here when ready. :thumbsup:
alice: i'll follow up with infra to rollback the automation change and add a safety gate in deploy-runbook-bot.
lee: thanks all. adding note to oncall handoff that night-overlay must be explicitly reviewed before next deploy.
maria: closing incident thread for now — will re-open if we see follow-up pages.
